svg.desc: Segmented bar, 4 parts of $850m. Fudge Factory: $60m, 7%. Macaron Mills: $180m, 21%. Praline Partners: $520m, 61%. Sorbet Co: $90m, 11%. Arrow keys step through the values. Home and End jump to the ends. Escape closes.
